_about: Page patterns for websites (section order) and shells for webapps. Sections reference references/website-playbook.md, shells reference references/webapp-playbook.md.

saas-landing.name: SaaS landing
sections: hero: promise + subline + primary CTA + product visual
saas-landing.cta: hero + after pricing + final; sticky nav CTA
saas-landing.notes: Show the real product in the hero. One signature effect max.

local-business.name: Local business (Handwerk, Praxis, Restaurant)
sections: hero: what + where + photo of real work/team + call/WhatsApp/form
trust strip: Google rating, years, Meisterbetrieb/certificates
services as cards with prices or 'ab'-prices
local-business.cta: phone/WhatsApp/form above the fold and sticky on mobile (bottom bar)
local-business.notes: Local SEO: NAP consistent, LocalBusiness schema, city in H1/title. Speed over effects.

agency-portfolio.name: Agency / portfolio
sections: statement hero (kinetic type or one visual)
agency-portfolio.notes: Work first, talk later. Case study pages: challenge → approach → result with numbers.

product-launch.name: Product launch / storytelling
product-launch.notes: Apple pattern. Reduced motion → stacked stills.

lead-magnet.name: Lead magnet / webinar
sections: hero with form above the fold (≤ 3 fields)
lead-magnet.notes: No nav or minimal nav to reduce exits.

event.name: Event / conference
sections: hero: name, date, place, ticket CTA, countdown optional
event.cta: tickets in nav + hero + after agenda
event.notes: Add to calendar (ics). Countdown needs aria-live off.

ecommerce.name: E-commerce storefront
ecommerce.cta: add to cart on product cards and PDP
ecommerce.notes: Baymard: costs early, guest checkout, filters with chips.

content-blog.name: Content / blog / newsletter
content-blog.notes: Reading comfort: 65ch, 18px body, TOC on long posts.

waitlist.name: Waitlist / coming soon
waitlist.notes: One screen. Confirm with double opt-in (DE).

sidebar-shell.name: Sidebar app shell
layout: collapsible sidebar (workspace switcher, primary nav, secondary nav, user)
content with max-width or fluid for data

list-detail.name: List ↔ detail
layout: detail in side panel (non-modal) or route

editor-canvas.name: Editor / canvas
editor-canvas.use: design tools, builders, whiteboards, CMS page builder
